attributes.title: 2027 North Carolina Annual Scientific Session: The Art & Heart of Internal Medicine
attributes.series: ACP North Carolina Chapter Annual Scientific Session
attributes.summary:
The North Carolina Chapter of the American College of Physicians meets at the Friday Conference Center in Chapel Hill from February 12 to 14, 2027. This year's program is titled "The Art & Heart of Internal Medicine" and is aimed at internists, residents and students, with poster sessions for trainees and early-career physicians. The chapter says CME and MOC credit will be provided but had not posted totals.

Registration covers meals, sessions, materials and the Doctor's Dilemma dinner. Early rates through December 31, 2026, are $310 for ACP members and $475 for nonmember physicians, rising to $350 and $550 afterward. Nonmember allied health professionals pay $274 early, and residents and students pay $25. Cancellations before January 28 are refunded minus $25.

The Courtyard by Marriott Chapel Hill holds rooms at $209 a night until January 29, 2027.
